design_philosophy: Vibrant B2B Marketplace. High trust, precision, workflow-centric but visually energetic. No AI-slop purple. Focus on 'Swiss & High-Contrast' archetype mixed with vibrant accents.

headings.usage: Use for all marketing headings, storefront heroes, and primary page titles.

body.usage: Clean, readable body text for product descriptions, reviews, and general UI.

data_sku.usage: Use for SKUs, order IDs, pricing tables, dimensions, and technical specs.

colors.css_variables_instruction: Provide color tokens as CSS variables so admin theme editor can override them without code changes.

primary.name: Electric Azure
primary.usage: Primary CTAs, active states, key highlights. High energy, trust-building.

secondary.name: Deep Indigo
secondary.usage: Headers, footers, typography, high-contrast dark backgrounds.

accent.name: Vibrant Blaze
accent.usage: Flash sales, deals, notification dots, urgent actions.

background.name: Cool Slate
background.usage: Main app background. Never pure white for the whole page.

border.name: Crisp Border
border.usage: 1px structural dividers. Use heavily for grid borders and bento layouts.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing, Mobile-First. Structural bento grids for marketing, dense high-utility grids for dashboards.
spacing_and_layout.storefront_hero: Bento Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6. Hero banner spans 8 cols, side promos span 4.
spacing_and_layout.product_grid: Dense bento. grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-5. 1px solid borders, no shadows.
spacing_and_layout.dashboards: Strict 12-column grid. High density, compact spacing (gap-4). Cardless approach: use sharp 1px borders instead of drop shadows.

ui_components.header_mega_menu: White/Glassmorphic header. Mega-menu opens on hover with 3-column layout for categories/subcategories and 1-column on right for promo image.
ui_components.buttons: Sharp corners or slight radius (rounded-md). High contrast text. Use solid Primary for 'Add to Cart' or 'Request Quote'.
ui_components.cards: Flat, sharp edges, 1px border. No soft shadows. Use hover translateY(-2px) and border color change.
ui_components.badges: Pill-shaped, bold colors (e.g., Yellow for MOQ, Red for Flash Sale, Blue for Verified Vendor).
ui_components.tables: Zebra striping or distinct 1px border bottom. Use Shadcn Table. Align numerical data right, text left.

marketplace_specifics.product_listing: Filters on left (collapsible on mobile). Infinite scroll or pagination. Product cards must show: Image, Vendor name, Title, Tiered price (e.g., $10-$15), MOQ, Rating.
marketplace_specifics.product_detail_page: Split layout. Left: Image gallery + Sticky thumbnail column. Right: Title, Vendor Trust Badge, Tier Pricing Table (Buy more, save more), MOQ selector, RFQ button, Add to Cart. Bottom: Tabs for Specs, Vendor Info, Reviews.
marketplace_specifics.vendor_dashboard: KPI cards at top. Sidebar navigation. High-density data tables for Orders, Inventory, RFQs.
marketplace_specifics.admin_theme_editor: Sidebar with color pickers (Primary, Secondary, Background), logo upload, font selector. Main content area previews the changes in real-time.

category_promos.description: Automated conveyor/production line for category promo in mega-menu

motion.hover_states: Quick transitions (duration-200 ease-out) on buttons and cards.
motion.page_transitions: Subtle fade-in for product listings and dashboards.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure pure hex primary colors pass APCA contrast with their text.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-btn').
accessibility.focus: High visibility focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:ring-offset-2) on all form elements and buttons.

visual_enhancers.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for a premium B2B look (duotone weight).
visual_enhancers.borders: Use the 'Grid Borders' style for feature sections and footer: exposing the grid skeleton.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use sparingly, only for sticky header: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-gray-200. Never use pure transparent backgrounds.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize implementing CSS variables for the color palette in index.css so the Admin Theme Editor can easily modify them at runtime.
For the Storefront, build custom HTML/Tailwind layouts for high-impact visual sections (Hero, Featured Categories).
For Dashboards and Forms, rely heavily on customized Shadcn UI components.
Ensure all data tables (Orders, Customers, Vendors) in the admin and vendor panels handle large datasets visually by using compact row heights and monospace fonts for IDs.
Use Phosphor icons. Command: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react
Use Sonner for toast notifications (e.g., 'Added to cart', 'RFQ Sent').
Do NOT use HTML <select> or <input type='date'>. Use Shadcn Select and Calendar components.
Never use pure transparent backgrounds for headers or overlays. Always use a blur or semi-solid background.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc. for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones.
